$description: Rem0te design tokens, draft 0 (0.85.1). Planning values from the owner's UI/UX directive §5, with WCAG 2.2 AA variants worked out against them. IN THE CODE SINCE 0.87.0: apps/web/app/globals.css carries these values as the shadcn HSL variables, plus --status-* and --nav-*; one deliberate difference, dark --primary is #60A5FA (primary-text) with dark ink, 7.4:1 (docs/UI_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md). The shared MSPZero specification (github.com/agit8or1/clientst0r/tree/main/docs/ux) was not published when this was written (checked against clientst0r main 2d26c30, 2026-11-25); when it is, this file follows it and records the adopted commit in CLIENTST0R_HANDOFF.md. Every ratio below was computed, not estimated; see SHARED_DESIGN_SYSTEM.md#contrast.

navigation.$description: Sidebar and app-switcher background, both themes. White text 15.6:1; muted #A9B8CC 7.8:1.

text-muted.$description: 5.4:1 on surface, 5.05:1 on background. #64748B (shadcn's slate-500) is 4.43:1 on background and fails.

border-strong.$description: Input and control outlines: 2.8:1 is under 3:1, so inputs also carry a background change; use control-outline for a lone boundary.

control-outline.$description: 4.8:1, for a boundary that is the only cue (checkbox, radio, toggle off-state).

primary.$description: Buttons with white text 5.2:1; as text 4.8:1 on background.

accent.$description: Fill and icon only (3.7:1). Text uses accent-text.

focus-ring.$description: 2px ring plus 2px offset; 5.2:1 against surface (non-text needs 3:1).

disabled-fg.$description: Disabled controls are exempt from contrast, but every disabled control must also say why (title or adjacent text).

primary.$description: Icons, selection and chart series only. White on #3B82F6 is 3.7:1 and fails, so a filled button in dark keeps primary-button (#2563EB, white 5.2:1), and primary as text or a link uses primary-text.

status.$description: One hue per meaning, in both themes. `base` is the directive's value, for fills, icons, chart series and 3px status bars (non-text, 3:1). `text-light` / `text-dark` are for words in that colour. `soft-*` is a tinted background behind text-* words. A status is never colour alone: it always has a word or an icon with an accessible name.

button.$description: White on the base #16A34A is 3.3:1 and fails; a filled success button uses #15803D (5.0:1).

button-fg.$description: A filled warning control takes dark text; white on #D97706 is 3.2:1.

unknown.$description: Unknown, stale, unsupported and unavailable: never green. The word distinguishes them (UX_ACCEPTANCE_CRITERIA.md U-3).

sans.$description: Inter, bundled with the app (no runtime request to another server). Today next/font/google fetches it at build time and serves it locally.

xs.$description: Smallest text. Replaces the 97 text-[11px] and 45 text-[10px] uses found in the audit.

2xl.$description: Dashboard figures only; never a heading.

density.$description: Touch targets stay at least 24×24 CSS px in compact (WCAG 2.2 2.5.8) and 44px on coarse pointers.

lg.$description: Cards and dialogs. The console's --radius is 0.5rem (8px) today.

raised.$description: Cards: a border plus at most this.

motion.$description: Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is 0 and spinners become a static icon with text.

set.$value: lucide (lucide-react, ISC), bundled; already the console's only icon set
